who_pays: Wings Credit Union (formerly Ent) pays it — a $50 electronic gift card (Visa or Amazon) for you and $50 for your friend, delivered by email. It's a gift card, not cash.
who_qualifies: You must be 18+ with an active Wings account in good standing. Your friend must be 18+, not already a Wings member, and qualify for membership — they live, work, worship, or go to school in the served areas, have a military affiliation, or are family of a member.

what_gets_accepted: Your friend must open a share savings account with a $5 deposit AND a No Strings or Broncos Checking account, then deposit $100 of their own money into checking and activate the debit card within 30 days. Miss the deposit or the card activation and nobody gets paid.
costs_and_unpaid_time: It costs you nothing to refer. The unpaid work is convincing a friend to move $105 ($5 savings plus $100 checking) into a new credit union and following up so they hit both steps within 30 days — if they don't, you earn nothing.
when_cash_arrives: Within 5 business days after the credit union verifies your friend met all the requirements, you both get an email to redeem your $50 electronic gift card.
